That figure is not in the repository: vf08/rows.json carries no row for this family and vf08/repair-assignments.json carries no entry for it. Measured fresh here, requiredOptionsMissing is 0. Separately, the four page-1 eligibility recitals are left unticked BY DESIGN, not by misplacement: two are declared NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE because they are the Sec. 61-11-26a branch and this family is Sec. 61-11-26, and the other two turn on the nonviolent determination and the same-transaction analysis, which the committed record calls legal conclusions and which Sec. 61-11-26(p)(5) makes express findings of the circuit court. Ticking them would assert a judicial finding on a petition sworn before a notary. The placement fix moves the court's own empty box outlines back onto their controls; it does not and must not make those elections.

sharedModuleVerdict.why: Matrix' = Matrix x A x translate(-Rect.x, -Rect.y) is exactly ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 less the translate pdf-lib's flatten() prepends. On an origin-anchored BBox with identity Matrix, A is translate(Rect.x, Rect.y) and Matrix' is the identity, so the correction is a proven no-op and is additionally skipped by MIN_CORRECTION_POINTS.
sharedModuleVerdict.provenNoOp: Against the pinned SCA-C907, 57 of 70 placements are origin-anchored: all 57 land on identical page coordinates with the correction on and off. Only the 13 malformed ones move.
